translations.idiomatic: Fan yielded the post to Minister of Ceremonies Hu Guang, Gentleman Consultant Wang Chang, and remitted convict Li Ying; the Emperor did not consent.

sentences.zh: 暢，龔之子也，嘗為南陽太守，疾其多貴戚豪族，下車，奮厲威猛，大姓有犯，或使吏發屋伐樹，堙井夷灶。

translations.literal: Chang was the son of Gong; he had once been Administrator of Nanyang. Grieved that the region had many noble clans and powerful families, upon taking office he exerted fierce and stern authority—when great clans offended, he sometimes had officials tear down houses and cut down trees, fill in wells and destroy stoves.
translations.idiomatic: Chang was Gong's son; he had once been Administrator of Nanyang. Grieved that the region abounded in noble clans and powerful families, upon taking office he exerted fierce and stern authority—when great clans offended, he sometimes had officials tear down houses and cut down trees, fill in wells and destroy stoves.

sentences.zh: 功曹張敞奏記諫曰：「文翁、召父、卓茂之徒，皆以溫厚為政，流聞後世。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk Zhang Chang submitted a remonstrance, saying, "Wen Weng, Lord Shao, Zhuo Mao, and men like them all governed with warmth and generosity, and their fame flowed down to later ages.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerk Zhang Chang submitted a remonstrance, saying, "Wen Weng, Lord Shao, Zhuo Mao, and men like them all governed with warmth and generosity, and their fame flowed down to later ages.

sentences.zh: 發屋伐樹，將為嚴烈，雖欲懲惡，難以聞遠。

translations.literal: Tearing down houses and cutting trees will become severity and harshness; though one wishes to punish evil, it is hard to make one's name heard afar.
translations.idiomatic: Tearing down houses and cutting trees will become severity and harshness; though one wishes to punish evil, it is hard to make one's reputation heard afar.

sentences.zh: 郡為舊都，侯甸之國，園廟出於章陵，三後生自新野，自中興以來，功臣將相，繼世而隆。

translations.literal: The commandery is an old capital, a state of marquis domains; gardens and temples arose from Zhangling, the Three Empresses were born from Xinye—from the Restoration onward, meritorious ministers and generals have risen in succession through the generations.
translations.idiomatic: The commandery is an old capital, a state of marquis domains; gardens and temples arose from Zhangling, the Three Empresses were born from Xinye—from the Restoration onward, meritorious ministers and generals have risen in succession through the generations.

sentences.zh: 愚以為懇懇用刑，不如行恩；

translations.literal: Your servant thinks that earnestly applying punishments is not as good as practicing grace;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant thinks that earnestly applying punishments is not as good as practicing grace;

sentences.zh: 孳孳求奸，未若禮賢。

translations.literal: diligently seeking out wrongdoing is not equal to honoring the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: diligently seeking out wrongdoing is not equal to honoring the worthy.

sentences.zh: 舜舉皋陶，不仁者遠，化人在德，不在用刑。

translations.literal: When Shun raised Gao Yao, the unkind kept far away—transforming people lies in virtue, not in using punishments.
translations.idiomatic: When Shun raised Gao Yao, the unkind kept far away—transforming people lies in virtue, not in using punishments.

sentences.zh: 」暢深納其言，更崇寬政，教化大行。

translations.literal: " Chang deeply accepted his words, further honored lenient government, and instruction and transformation were greatly carried out.
translations.idiomatic: " Chang deeply accepted his words, further honored lenient government, and instruction and transformation flourished.

sentences.zh: 八月，戊辰，初令郡國有田者畝斂稅錢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuchen, for the first time an order was issued that commanderies and kingdoms with fields should levy tax money per mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuchen day, for the first time an order was issued that commanderies and kingdoms with fields should levy tax money per mu.

sentences.zh: 九月，丁未，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dingwei, the capital region suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingwei day, the capital region suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，司空周景免；

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Minister of Works Zhou Jing was dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, Minister of Works Zhou Jing was dismissed;

sentences.zh: 以太常劉茂為司空，茂，愷之子也。

translations.literal: Minister of Ceremonies Liu Mao was made Minister of Works; Mao was the son of Kai.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Ceremonies Liu Mao was made Minister of Works; Mao was Kai's son.

sentences.zh: 郎中竇武，融之玄孫也，有女為貴人。

translations.literal: Gentleman of the Palace Dou Wu, a great-great-grandson of Rong, had a daughter who was an Imperial Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman of the Palace Dou Wu, a great-great-grandson of Rong, had a daughter who was an Imperial Consort.

sentences.zh: 采女田聖有寵於帝，帝將立之為後。

translations.literal: The palace woman Tian Sheng had the Emperor's favor, and the Emperor was about to establish her as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The palace woman Tian Sheng had the Emperor's favor, and the Emperor was about to establish her as Empress.

sentences.zh: 司隸校尉應奉上書曰：「母后之重，興廢所因；

translations.literal: Director of Corrections Ying Feng submitted a memorial, saying, "The weight of the Empress is the cause by which thrones are raised and cast down;
translations.idiomatic: Director of Corrections Ying Feng submitted a memorial, saying, "The weight of the Empress is the cause by which thrones are raised and cast down;

sentences.zh: 漢立飛燕，胤嗣泯絕。

translations.literal: when Han established Flying Swallow, the line of heirs was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: when Han established Flying Swallow, the line of heirs was extinguished.

sentences.zh: 宜思《關雎》之所求，遠五禁之所忌。

translations.literal: One should reflect on what the Guan Ju seeks and keep far from what the Five Prohibitions forbid.
translations.idiomatic: One should reflect on what the Guan Ju seeks and keep far from what the Five Prohibitions forbid.

sentences.zh: 」太尉陳蕃亦以田氏卑微，竇族良家，爭之甚固。

translations.literal: " Grand Commandant Chen Fan also, because the Tian clan was lowly and the Dou clan a good family, contended against it with great firmness.
translations.idiomatic: " Grand Commandant Chen Fan also, because the Tian clan was lowly and the Dou clan a good family, contended against it with great firmness.

sentences.zh: 帝不得已，辛巳，立竇貴人為皇后，拜武為特進、城門校尉，封槐裡侯。

translations.literal: The Emperor, having no choice, on xinsi day established Imperial Consort Dou as Empress, appointed Wu as Special Counselor and Colonel of the City Gates, and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Huaili.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, having no choice, on xinsi day established Imperial Consort Dou as Empress, appointed Wu as Special Counselor and Colonel of the City Gates, and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Huaili.

sentences.zh: 十一月，壬子，黃門北寺火。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renzi, the Northern Temple of the Yellow Gates caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi day, the Northern Temple of the Yellow Gates caught fire.

sentences.zh: 陳蕃數言李膺、馮緄、劉祐之枉，請加原宥，升之爵任，言及反覆，誠辭懇切，以至流涕；

translations.literal: Chen Fan repeatedly spoke of the injustice done to Li Ying, Feng Gun, and Liu You, requesting added pardon and promotion in rank and office; his words were repeated and turned back upon themselves, sincere and earnest in expression, until he wept.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Fan repeatedly spoke of the injustice done to Li Ying, Feng Gun, and Liu You, requesting pardon and promotion in rank and office; his words were repeated and turned back upon themselves, sincere and earnest in expression, until he wept.

sentences.zh: 帝不聽。

translations.literal: The Emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 應奉上疏曰：「夫忠賢武將，國之心膂。

translations.literal: Ying Feng submitted a memorial, saying, "Loyal ministers and worthy generals are the heart and backbone of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Feng submitted a memorial, saying, "Loyal ministers and worthy generals are the heart and backbone of the state.

sentences.zh: 竊見左校弛刑徒馮緄、劉祐、李膺等，誅舉邪臣，肆之以法；

translations.literal: Your servant has observed that remitted convicts of the Left Commandant Feng Gun, Liu You, Li Ying, and others investigated and reported wicked ministers and applied the law to them without restraint;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has observed that remitted convicts of the Left Commandant Feng Gun, Liu You, Li Ying, and others investigated and reported wicked ministers and applied the law to them without restraint;

sentences.zh: 陛下既不聽察，而猥受譖訴，遂令忠臣同愆元惡，自春迄冬，不蒙降恕，遐邇觀聽，為之歎息。

translations.literal: Your Majesty neither listened nor examined the matter, but rashly accepted slanderous accusations, and thus caused loyal ministers to share guilt with the chief villain. From spring through winter they received no reduction of punishment; near and far, all who saw and heard sighed for them.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty neither listened nor examined the matter, but rashly accepted slanderous accusations, and thus caused loyal ministers to share guilt with the chief villain. From spring through winter they received no reduction of punishment; near and far, all who saw and heard sighed for them.

sentences.zh: 夫立政之要，記功忘失；

translations.literal: The essential point in establishing government is to record merit and forget faults;
translations.idiomatic: The essential point in establishing government is to record merit and forget faults;

sentences.zh: 是以武帝捨安國於徒中，宣帝征張敞於亡命。

translations.literal: therefore Emperor Wu released An Guo from among convicts, and Emperor Xuan summoned Zhang Chang from among fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: therefore Emperor Wu released An Guo from among convicts, and Emperor Xuan summoned Zhang Chang from among fugitives.

sentences.zh: 緄前討蠻荊，均吉甫之功；

translations.literal: Gun earlier punished the barbarians of Jing and matched the achievement of Lord Ji;
translations.idiomatic: Gun earlier punished the barbarians of Jing and matched the achievement of Lord Ji;

sentences.zh: 祐數臨督司，有不吐茹之節；

translations.literal: You repeatedly supervised the inspectorates and possessed the integrity not to swallow wrongdoing;
translations.idiomatic: You repeatedly supervised the inspectorates and possessed the integrity not to swallow wrongdoing;

sentences.zh: 膺著威幽、并，遺愛度遼。

translations.literal: Ying established authority in You and Bing and left enduring love at Du Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Ying established authority in You and Bing and left enduring love at Du Liao.

sentences.zh: 今三垂蠢動，王旅未振，乞原膺等，以備不虞。

translations.literal: Now the three frontiers stir with unrest and the royal army has not yet recovered; I beg that Ying and the others be pardoned to guard against the unforeseen.
translations.idiomatic: Now the three frontiers stir with unrest and the royal army has not yet recovered; I beg that Ying and the others be pardoned to guard against the unforeseen.

sentences.zh: 」書奏，乃悉免其刑。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, all their punishments were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, all their punishments were remitted.

sentences.zh: 久之，李膺復拜司隸校尉。

translations.literal: After some time, Li Ying was again appointed Director of Corrections.
translations.idiomatic: After some time, Li Ying was again appointed Director of Corrections.

sentences.zh: 時小黃門張讓弟朔為野王令，貪殘無道，畏膺威嚴，逃還京師，匿于兄家合柱中。

translations.literal: At this time the Junior Palace Attendant Zhang Rang's younger brother Shuo was Magistrate of Yewang; greedy and cruel without principle, he feared Ying's stern authority, fled back to the capital, and hid in the hollow pillar of his elder brother's house.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Junior Palace Attendant Zhang Rang's younger brother Shuo was Magistrate of Yewang; greedy and cruel without principle, he feared Ying's stern authority, fled back to the capital, and hid in the hollow pillar of his elder brother's house.

sentences.zh: 膺知其狀，率吏卒破柱取朔，付雒陽獄，受辭畢，即殺之。

translations.literal: Ying learned the circumstances, led officials and soldiers to break the pillar and seize Shuo, handed him over to the Luoyang prison, and once his confession was complete immediately executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Ying learned the circumstances, led officials and soldiers to break the pillar and seize Shuo, handed him over to the Luoyang prison, and once his confession was complete immediately executed him.

sentences.zh: 讓訴冤於帝，帝召膺，詰以不先請便加誅之意。

translations.literal: Rang pleaded injustice before the Emperor; the Emperor summoned Ying and questioned him on the meaning of executing without prior request.
translations.idiomatic: Rang pleaded injustice before the Emperor; the Emperor summoned Ying and questioned him on executing without prior request.

sentences.zh: 對曰：「昔仲尼為魯司寇，七日而誅少正卯。

translations.literal: He replied, "Formerly Confucius served as Minister of Crime of Lu and within seven days executed Shao Zheng Mao.
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "Formerly Confucius served as Minister of Crime of Lu and within seven days executed Shao Zheng Mao.

sentences.zh: 今臣到官已積一旬，私懼以稽留為愆，不意獲速疾之罪。

translations.literal: Now your servant has held office for a full ten days; I privately feared that delay would be fault, and did not expect to receive the crime of excessive haste.
translations.idiomatic: Now your servant has held office for a full ten days; I privately feared that delay would be fault, and did not expect to receive the crime of excessive haste.

sentences.zh: 誠自知釁責，死不旋踵，特乞留五日，克殄元惡，退就鼎鑊，始生之願也。

translations.literal: I truly know my guilt and would die without turning my heel; I only beg to be kept five days more to destroy the chief villain, then withdraw to the cauldron—this is the wish of my whole life.
translations.idiomatic: I truly know my guilt and would die without turning my heel; I only beg to be kept five days more to destroy the chief villain, then withdraw to the cauldron—this is the wish of my whole life.

sentences.zh: 」帝無復言，顧謂讓曰：「此汝弟之罪，司隸何愆！

translations.literal: " The Emperor said nothing more, but turned and said to Rang, "This is your younger brother's crime—what fault has the Director of Corrections!
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said nothing more, but turned and said to Rang, "This is your younger brother's crime—what fault has the Director of Corrections!

sentences.zh: 」乃遣出。

translations.literal: " He then sent him out.
translations.idiomatic: " He then sent him out.

sentences.zh: 自此諸黃門、常侍皆鞠躬屏氣，休沐不敢出宮省。

translations.literal: From this onward all the Yellow Gates and Regular Attendants bowed with bated breath; on days of rest they did not dare leave the palace offices.
translations.idiomatic: From this onward all the Yellow Gates and Regular Attendants bowed with bated breath; on days of rest they did not dare leave the palace offices.

sentences.zh: 帝怪問其故，並叩頭泣曰：「畏李校尉。

translations.literal: The Emperor, wondering at the cause, asked; they all kowtowed weeping and said, "We fear Director of Corrections Li.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, wondering at the cause, asked; they all kowtowed weeping and said, "We fear Director of Corrections Li.

sentences.zh: 」時朝廷日亂，綱紀頹弛，而膺獨特風裁，以聲名自高，士有被其容接者，名為登龍門雲。

translations.literal: " At this time the court daily grew more chaotic and discipline slackened, yet Ying alone maintained stern standards and raised himself by reputation; scholars who received his attention were said to have ascended the Dragon Gate.
translations.idiomatic: " At this time the court daily grew more chaotic and discipline slackened, yet Ying alone maintained stern standards and raised himself by reputation; scholars who received his attention were said to have ascended the Dragon Gate.

sentences.zh: 征東海相劉寬為尚書令。

translations.literal: Liu Kuan, Chancellor of Donghai, was summoned as Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Kuan, Chancellor of Donghai, was summoned as Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 寬，崎之子也，歷典三郡，溫仁多恕，雖在倉卒，未嘗疾言遽色。

translations.literal: Kuan was the son of Qi; he had successively governed three commanderies. Warm and benevolent, greatly forgiving, even in sudden haste he never spoke harshly or showed a startled countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan was Qi's son; he had successively governed three commanderies. Warm and benevolent, greatly forgiving, even in sudden haste he never spoke harshly or showed a startled countenance.

sentences.zh: 吏民有過，但用蒲鞭罰之，示辱而已，終不加苦。

translations.literal: When officials or common people erred, he only punished them with a cattail whip to show disgrace and nothing more, never adding further suffering.
translations.idiomatic: When officials or common people erred, he only punished them with a cattail whip to show disgrace and nothing more, never adding further suffering.

sentences.zh: 每見父老，慰以農裡之言，少年，勉以孝悌之訓，人皆悅而化之。

translations.literal: Whenever he saw elders of the community he comforted them with words of farming and village life; to the young he exhorted filial piety and brotherly duty—and all were pleased and transformed by him.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he saw elders of the community he comforted them with words of farming and village life; to the young he exhorted filial piety and brotherly duty—and all were pleased and transformed by him.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，辛卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the first day xinmao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on the first day xinmao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 詔公卿、郡國舉至孝。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the excellencies, ministers, commanderies, and kingdoms to recommend supreme filial sons.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the excellencies, ministers, commanderies, and kingdoms to recommend supreme filial sons.

sentences.zh: 太常趙典所舉荀爽對策曰：「昔者聖人建天地之中而謂之禮，眾禮之中，昏禮為首。

translations.literal: Xun Shuang, recommended by Minister of Ceremonies Zhao Dian, answered in the examination, saying, "Formerly the sages established the mean between Heaven and Earth and called it ritual; among all rituals, marriage ritual comes first.
translations.idiomatic: Xun Shuang, recommended by Minister of Ceremonies Zhao Dian, answered in the examination, saying, "Formerly the sages established the mean between Heaven and Earth and called it ritual; among all rituals, marriage ritual comes first.

sentences.zh: 陽性純而能施，陰體順而能化，以禮濟樂，節宣其氣，故能豐子孫之祥，致老壽之福。

translations.literal: Yang nature is pure and able to give forth; yin substance is compliant and able to transform. Using ritual to balance music and regulate and disperse its qi, one can therefore enrich the auspice of descendants and attain the blessing of long old age.
translations.idiomatic: Yang nature is pure and able to give forth; yin substance is compliant and able to transform. Using ritual to balance music and regulate and disperse its qi, one can therefore enrich the auspice of descendants and attain the blessing of long old age.

sentences.zh: 及三代之季，淫而無節，陽竭於上，陰隔於下，故周公之戒曰：『時亦罔或克壽。

translations.literal: By the end of the Three Dynasties there was excess without restraint; yang was exhausted above and yin blocked below. Therefore the warning of the Duke of Zhou says, "Then too none could attain long life.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of the Three Dynasties there was excess without restraint; yang was exhausted above and yin blocked below. Therefore the warning of the Duke of Zhou says, "Then too none could attain long life.

sentences.zh: 』《傳》曰：『截趾適屨，孰雲其愚，何與斯人，追欲喪軀。

translations.literal: " The Commentary says, "Cutting off the toes to fit the shoes—who would call that wise? Why follow such men, chasing desire to lose one's body?
translations.idiomatic: " The Commentary says, "Cutting off the toes to fit the shoes—who would call that wise? Why follow such men, chasing desire to lose one's body?

sentences.zh: 』誠可痛也。

translations.literal: " Truly this is painful to consider.
translations.idiomatic: " Truly this is painful to consider.

sentences.zh: 臣竊聞後宮采女五六千人，從官、侍使復在其外，空賦不辜之民，以供無用之女，百姓窮困於外，陰陽隔塞於內，故感動和氣，災異屢臻。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that the palace women of the rear palace number five or six thousand, with attendants and serving maids beyond them besides; empty taxes are levied on innocent people to supply useless women. The common people are impoverished without and yin and yang are blocked within—therefore harmonious qi is moved and disasters and anomalies repeatedly arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has heard that the palace women of the rear palace number five or six thousand, with attendants and serving maids beyond them besides; innocent people are taxed to supply useless women. The common people are impoverished without and yin and yang are blocked within—therefore harmonious qi is disturbed and disasters and anomalies repeatedly arrive.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為諸未幸御者，一皆遣出，使成妃合，此誠國家之大福也。

translations.literal: Your servant thinks that all who have not yet received imperial favor should one and all be sent out so that they may become wives—this is truly a great blessing to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant thinks that all who have not yet received imperial favor should one and all be sent out so that they may become wives—this is truly a great blessing to the state.

sentences.zh: 」詔拜郎中。

translations.literal: " An edict appointed him Gentleman of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict appointed him Gentleman of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 司隸、豫州饑，死者什四五，至有滅戶者。

translations.literal: In the Inspectorate of the Capital Region and Yu Province there was famine; of those who died, four or five in ten, and there were even households extinguished entirely.
translations.idiomatic: In the Inspectorate of the Capital Region and Yu Province there was famine; of those who died, four or five in ten, and there were even households extinguished entirely.

sentences.zh: 詔征張奐為大司農，復以皇甫規代為度遼將軍。

translations.literal: An edict summoned Zhang Huan as Grand Minister of Agriculture, and Huangfu Gui was again made General Who Crosses the Liao in his place.
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned Zhang Huan as Grand Minister of Agriculture, and Huangfu Gui was again made General Who Crosses the Liao in his place.

sentences.zh: 規自以連在大位，欲求退避，數上病，不見聽。

translations.literal: Gui, considering that he had held high office in succession and wishing to withdraw and avoid prominence, repeatedly submitted illness, but was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Gui, considering that he had held high office in succession and wishing to withdraw and avoid prominence, repeatedly submitted illness, but was not heeded.

sentences.zh: 會友人喪至，規越界迎之，因令客密告并州刺史胡芳，言規擅遠軍營，當急舉奏。

translations.literal: It happened that a friend's funeral arrived; Gui crossed the border to meet it and therefore had a guest secretly inform Bing Province Inspector Hu Fang that Gui had left his army camp without authorization and should urgently be reported and impeached.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that a friend's funeral arrived; Gui crossed the border to meet it and therefore had a guest secretly inform Bing Province Inspector Hu Fang that Gui had left his army camp without authorization and should urgently be reported and impeached.

sentences.zh: 芳曰：「威明欲避第仕塗，故激發我耳。

translations.literal: Fang said, "Weiming wishes to leave office and avoid the path of official advancement, and therefore provokes me.
translations.idiomatic: Fang said, "Weiming wishes to leave office and avoid the path of official advancement, and therefore provokes me.

sentences.zh: 吾當為朝廷愛才，何能申此子計邪！

translations.literal: I ought to cherish talent for the court—how could I carry out this man's plan!
translations.idiomatic: I ought to cherish talent for the court—how could I carry out this man's plan!

sentences.zh: 」遂無所問。

translations.literal: " Thereupon nothing was investigated.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon nothing was investigated.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，濟陰、東郡、濟北、平原河水清。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the river water of Jiyin, Dong, Jibei, and Pingyuan became clear.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, the river water of Jiyin, Dong, Jibei, and Pingyuan became clear.

sentences.zh: 司徒許栩免；

translations.literal: Minister over the Masses Xu Xu was dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: Minister over the Masses Xu Xu was dismissed;

sentences.zh: 五月，以太常胡廣為司徒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Minister of Ceremonies Hu Guang was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Minister of Ceremonies Hu Guang was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上親祠老子於濯龍宮，以文罽為壇飾，淳金釦器，設華蓋之坐，用郊天樂。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu the Emperor personally sacrificed to Laozi at the Washing Dragon Palace, using patterned felt for altar adornments, pure gold clasps on vessels, setting up a canopy seat, and using the music of suburban sacrifice to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor personally sacrificed to Laozi at the Washing Dragon Palace, using patterned felt for altar adornments, pure gold clasps on vessels, setting up a canopy seat, and using the music of suburban sacrifice to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑聞張奐去，招結南匈奴及烏桓同叛。

translations.literal: The Xianbei, hearing that Zhang Huan had departed, recruited and joined the Southern Xiongnu and Wuhuan in common rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei, hearing that Zhang Huan had departed, recruited and joined the Southern Xiongnu and Wuhuan in common rebellion.

sentences.zh: 六月，南匈奴、烏桓、鮮卑數道入塞，寇掠緣邊九郡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Southern Xiongnu, Wuhuan, and Xianbei entered the frontier by several routes and raided and plundered nine commanderies along the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Southern Xiongnu, Wuhuan, and Xianbei entered the frontier by several routes and raided and plundered nine commanderies along the border.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，鮮卑復入塞，誘引東羌與共盟詛。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Xianbei again entered the frontier, enticing and leading the Eastern Qiang to join in covenant and curse.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, the Xianbei again entered the frontier, enticing and leading the Eastern Qiang to join in covenant and curse.

sentences.zh: 於是上郡沈氐、安定先零諸種共寇武威、張掖，緣邊大被其毒。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Shen Di of Shang commandery, the Xianling of Anding, and the various tribes jointly raided Wuwei and Zhangye, and the border regions suffered greatly from their depredations.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Shen Di of Shang commandery, the Xianling of Anding, and allied tribes jointly attacked Wuwei and Zhangye, and the frontier suffered heavily.

sentences.zh: 詔復以張奐為護匈奴中郎將，以九卿秩督幽、并、涼三州及度遼、烏桓二營，兼察刺史、二千石能否。

translations.literal: An edict again appointed Zhang Huan as General of the Gentlemen-of-the-Household Who Protect the Xiongnu, with the rank of the Nine Ministers to oversee You, Bing, and Liang provinces and the two camps of Du Liao and Wuhuan, and also to inspect the ability of regional inspectors and the two-thousand-bushel officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict again appointed Zhang Huan General Who Protects the Xiongnu, with Nine-Minister rank to supervise You, Bing, and Liang provinces and the Du Liao and Wuhuan camps, and to review the competence of inspectors and commandery administrators.

sentences.zh: 初，帝為蠡吾侯，受學於甘陵周福，及即位，擢福為尚書。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Emperor was Marquis of Liyi, he studied under Zhou Fu of Ganling; when he ascended the throne, he promoted Fu to Master of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while still Marquis of Liyi, the Emperor had studied under Zhou Fu of Ganling; upon his accession he promoted Fu to Master of Writing.

sentences.zh: 時同郡河南尹房植有名當朝，鄉人為之謠曰：「天下規矩，房伯武；

translations.literal: At the time, Intendant of Henan Fang Zhi of the same commandery was renowned at court, and the people of the district made a song about him, saying: "The standards of all under heaven—Fang Bowu;
translations.idiomatic: At the time Fang Zhi, Intendant of Henan and a fellow townsman, was famed at court, and locals sang of him: "The measure of all under heaven—Fang Bowu;

sentences.zh: 因師獲印，周仲進。

translations.literal: Through his teacher he gained the seal—Zhou Zhongjin.
translations.idiomatic: Through his teacher he gained the seal—Zhou Zhongjin.

sentences.zh: 」二家賓客，互相譏揣，遂各樹朋徒，漸成尤隙。

translations.literal: " The retainers of the two houses mutually mocked and probed each other, and thus each established factions; grudges gradually deepened.
translations.idiomatic: " The retainers of the two households traded mockery and suspicion, each building a faction until enmity took root.

sentences.zh: 由是甘陵有南北部，黨人之議自此始矣。

translations.literal: From this, Ganling came to have a Northern and Southern faction, and partisan talk began from this point.
translations.idiomatic: From this Ganling acquired its Northern and Southern factions, and partisan politics began.

sentences.zh: 汝南太守宗資以范滂為功曹，南陽太守成□以岑晊為功曹，皆委心聽任，使之褒善糾違，肅清朝府。

translations.literal: Runan Administrator Zong Zi appointed Fan Pang as Merit Officer; Nanyang Administrator Cheng Ji appointed Cen Qi as Merit Officer; all entrusted them wholeheartedly, letting them praise good conduct and expose wrongdoing, and so purify the court and government.
translations.idiomatic: Runan Administrator Zong Zi made Fan Pang his Merit Officer, and Nanyang Administrator Cheng Ji made Cen Qi his; both gave them full trust to praise virtue, expose wrongdoing, and cleanse their administrations.

sentences.zh: 滂尤剛勁，疾惡如仇。

translations.literal: Pang was especially firm and stern, hating evil as if it were a personal enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Pang was especially resolute and stern, hating evil as one hates a personal foe.

sentences.zh: 滂甥李頌，素無行，中常侍唐衡以屬資，資用為吏；

translations.literal: Pang's nephew Li Song had always been without proper conduct; Regular Palace Attendant Tang Heng recommended him to Zi, and Zi employed him as an official;
translations.idiomatic: Pang's nephew Li Song was notoriously ill-behaved; Regular Palace Attendant Tang Heng recommended him to Zi, who took him on as an official;

sentences.zh: 滂寢而不召。

translations.literal: Pang lay down on the matter and did not summon him.
translations.idiomatic: Pang ignored the appointment and refused to call him in.

sentences.zh: 資遷怒，捶書佐朱零，零仰曰：「范滂清裁，今日寧受笞而死，滂不可違。

translations.literal: Zi redirected his anger and beat Clerk Assistant Zhu Ling; Ling looked up and said: "Fan Pang is clear in judgment; today I would rather be whipped to death—Pang cannot be disobeyed.
translations.idiomatic: Zi turned his wrath on Clerk Assistant Zhu Ling and beat him; Ling looked up and said: "Fan Pang is incorruptible in judgment; I would rather be flogged to death today than disobey Pang.

sentences.zh: 」資乃止。

translations.literal: Zi then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Zi then stopped.

sentences.zh: 郡中中人以下，莫不怨之。

translations.literal: Throughout the commandery, all from the middle ranks downward resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the commandery, everyone below the middle ranks resented him.

sentences.zh: 於是二郡為謠曰：「汝南太守范孟博，南陽宗資主畫諾；

translations.literal: Thereupon the two commanderies made a song, saying: "Runan Administrator Fan Mengbo; in Nanyang Zong Zi merely signs approval;
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the two commanderies sang: "Runan has Fan Mengbo as its real master; in Nanyang Zong Zi only stamps approval;

sentences.zh: 南陽太守岑公孝，弘農成□但坐嘯。

translations.literal: Nanyang Administrator Cen Gongxiao; in Hongnong Cheng Ji only sits and whistles.
translations.idiomatic: Nanyang has Cen Gongxiao; in Hongnong Cheng Ji only sits and whistles.

sentences.zh: 太學諸生三萬餘人，郭泰及穎川賈彪為其冠，與李膺、陳蕃、王暢更相褒重。

translations.literal: More than thirty thousand students in the Imperial Academy—Guo Tai and Jia Biao of Yingchuan were foremost among them, and with Li Ying, Chen Fan, and Wang Chang they mutually praised and honored one another.
translations.idiomatic: More than thirty thousand students filled the Imperial Academy; Guo Tai and Jia Biao of Yingchuan stood at their head, and with Li Ying, Chen Fan, and Wang Chang they held one another in the highest esteem.

sentences.zh: 學中語曰：「天下模楷，李元禮；

translations.literal: Among the students it was said: "The model for all under heaven—Li Yuanli;
translations.idiomatic: Among the students they said: "The model for all under heaven—Li Yuanli;

sentences.zh: 不畏強禦，陳仲舉；

translations.literal: Who fears not the powerful—Chen Zhongju;
translations.idiomatic: Who fears not the powerful—Chen Zhongju;

sentences.zh: 天下俊秀，王叔茂。

translations.literal: The finest talent under heaven—Wang Shumao.
translations.idiomatic: The finest talent under heaven—Wang Shumao.

sentences.zh: 」於是中外承風，競以臧否相尚，自公卿以下，莫不畏其貶議，屣履到門。

translations.literal: " Thereupon within and without all caught the prevailing wind, competing to praise and condemn; from the Three Excellencies and Nine Ministers downward, none did not fear their censures—they hastened shoeless to their doors.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon court and country took up the fashion, competing in praise and blame; from the highest ministers downward, all feared their censure and hurried shoeless to their doors.

sentences.zh: 宛有富賈張汎者，與後宮有親，又善雕鏤玩好之物，頗以賂遺中宮，以此得顯位，用勢縱橫。

translations.literal: In Wan there was a wealthy merchant Zhang Fan, related to the inner palace; skilled also at carving ornamental curios, he often bribed the inner palace with gifts; through this he gained a prominent position and wielded power recklessly.
translations.idiomatic: In Wan lived a wealthy merchant named Zhang Fan, connected to the inner palace; skilled at carving luxury goods, he lavished bribes on the eunuchs, won high office, and abused his power without restraint.

sentences.zh: 岑晊與賊曹史張牧勸成瑨收捕汎等，既而遇赦；

translations.literal: Cen Qi and Bandit-Catching Clerk Zhang Mu urged Cheng Ji to arrest Zhang Fan and the others; an amnesty then intervened;
translations.idiomatic: Cen Qi and Bandit-Catching Clerk Zhang Mu urged Cheng Ji to arrest Zhang Fan and his associates; an amnesty intervened;

sentences.zh: 瑨竟誅之，並收其宗族賓客，殺二百餘人，後乃奏聞。

translations.literal: Ji nevertheless executed them, seized their clans and retainers as well, killed more than two hundred people, and only afterward submitted a report to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Ji executed them anyway, seized their clans and retainers, killed more than two hundred people, and only afterward reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 小黃門晉陽趙津，貪橫放恣，為一縣巨患。

translations.literal: Junior Palace Attendant Zhao Jin of Jinyang was greedy, overbearing, and unrestrained—a scourge upon the whole county.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Palace Attendant Zhao Jin of Jinyang was greedy, violent, and unrestrained—the scourge of his county.

sentences.zh: 太原太守平原劉□質使郡吏王允討捕，亦於赦後殺之。

translations.literal: Taiyuan Administrator Liu Zhi of Pingyuan sent commandery official Wang Yun to capture him, and likewise killed him after the amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan Administrator Liu Zhi of Pingyuan sent commandery official Wang Yun to capture him and, likewise, killed him after the amnesty.

sentences.zh: 於是中常侍侯覽使張泛妻上書訟冤，宦官因緣譖訴瑨、□質。

translations.literal: Thereupon Regular Palace Attendant Hou Lan had Zhang Fan's wife submit a memorial pleading injustice; the eunuchs seized the occasion to slander Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Regular Palace Attendant Hou Lan had Zhang Fan's wife submit a memorial of grievance; the eunuchs used the occasion to slander Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，征瑨、□質，皆下獄。

translations.literal: The Emperor was greatly angered, summoned Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi, and both were imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was furious, recalled Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi, and both were thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 有司承旨，奏瑨、□質罪當棄市。

translations.literal: The responsible officials, following the imperial intent, memorialized that Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi's crimes merited execution in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials, reading the imperial mood, memorialized that Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi deserved execution in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 山陽太守翟超以郡人張儉為東部督郵。

translations.literal: Shanyang Administrator Zhai Chao appointed fellow townsman Zhang Jian as Eastern District Chief Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Shanyang Administrator Zhai Chao appointed his fellow townsman Zhang Jian Eastern District Chief Officer.

sentences.zh: 侯覽家在防東，殘暴百姓。

translations.literal: Hou Lan's family home was east of Fang; they brutalized the common people.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Lan's family estate lay east of Fang, where they brutalized the people.

sentences.zh: 覽喪母還家，大起塋塚。

translations.literal: Lan returned home for his mother's funeral and built a great tomb mound.
translations.idiomatic: Lan returned home to mourn his mother and raised a great tomb mound.

sentences.zh: 儉舉奏覽罪，而覽伺候遮截，章竟不上。

translations.literal: Jian submitted a memorial impeaching Lan for crimes, but Lan kept watch and intercepted it—the memorial never reached the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Jian memorialized to impeach Lan, but Lan intercepted the report and it never reached the throne.

sentences.zh: 儉遂破覽塚宅，藉沒資財，具奏其狀，復不得御。

translations.literal: Jian thereupon destroyed Lan's tomb and residence, confiscated his property, submitted a full report of the circumstances, and again it could not reach the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Jian then demolished Lan's tomb and residence, confiscated his property, submitted a full report—and again it never reached the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 徐璜兄子宣為下邳令，暴虐尤甚。

translations.literal: Xu Huang's nephew's son Xuan was Magistrate of Xiapi, especially cruel and tyrannical.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Huang's nephew's son Xuan was magistrate of Xiapi and was especially cruel and tyrannical.

sentences.zh: 嘗求故汝南太守李暠女不能得，遂將吏卒至家，載其女歸，戲射殺之。

translations.literal: Once he sought the daughter of former Runan Administrator Li Hao and could not obtain her; he then led officials and soldiers to her home, carried her daughter off, and killed her for sport with bow and arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Once he sought the daughter of former Runan Administrator Li Hao in vain; he led officials and soldiers to her home, carried her off, and killed her for sport with bow and arrow.

sentences.zh: 東海相汝南黃浮聞之，收宣家屬，無少長，悉考之。

translations.literal: Donghai Chancellor Huang Fu of Runan heard of it, seized Xuan's family members—none young or old exempt—and thoroughly investigated them all.
translations.idiomatic: Donghai Chancellor Huang Fu of Runan heard of it, seized every member of Xuan's household without regard to age, and investigated them all.

sentences.zh: 掾史以下固爭，浮曰：「徐宣國賊，今日殺之，明日坐死，足以瞑目矣！

translations.literal: The clerks and officials below firmly remonstrated; Fu said: "Xu Xuan is a traitor to the state; to kill him today and face death tomorrow is enough to close my eyes in peace!
translations.idiomatic: The clerks below remonstrated fiercely; Fu said: "Xu Xuan is a traitor to the state; to kill him today and die for it tomorrow is enough to close my eyes in peace!

sentences.zh: 」即案宣罪棄市，暴其屍，於是宦官訴冤於帝，帝大怒，超、浮並坐髡鉗，輸作右校。

translations.literal: " He immediately tried Xuan's case and executed him in the marketplace, exposing his corpse; thereupon the eunuchs pleaded injustice before the Emperor; the Emperor was greatly angered, and both Chao and Fu were punished with shaved heads and fetters, sent to labor at the Right Construction Office.
translations.idiomatic: " He immediately tried Xuan and executed him in the marketplace, exposing his corpse; the eunuchs then pleaded injustice before the Emperor, who was furious; Chao and Fu were both shaved, fettered, and sent to labor at the Right Construction Office.

sentences.zh: 太尉陳蕃、司空劉茂共諫，請□、□質、超、浮等罪；

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Chen Fan and Minister of Works Liu Mao jointly remonstrated, requesting pardon for Cheng Ji, Liu Zhi, Chao, Fu, and the others;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Chen Fan and Minister of Works Liu Mao jointly remonstrated, asking pardon for Cheng Ji, Liu Zhi, Chao, Fu, and the others;

sentences.zh: 帝不悅。

translations.literal: The Emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was displeased.

sentences.zh: 有司劾奏之，茂不敢復言。

translations.literal: The responsible officials impeached them; Mao dared speak no further.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials impeached them; Mao dared speak no further.

sentences.zh: 蕃乃獨上疏曰：「今寇賊在外，四支之疾；

translations.literal: Fan thereupon submitted a memorial alone, saying: "Now bandits and rebels are abroad—an ailment of the limbs;
translations.idiomatic: Fan then submitted a memorial alone, saying: "Now bandits and rebels are abroad—an ailment of the limbs;

sentences.zh: 內政不理，心腹之患。

translations.literal: Internal government goes unattended—a malady of the heart and belly.
translations.idiomatic: Internal government goes unattended—a malady of the heart and belly.

sentences.zh: 臣寢不能寐，食不能飽，實憂左右日親，忠言日疏，內患漸積，外難方深。

translations.literal: Your servant can sleep neither by night nor eat his fill by day, truly fearing that those close at hand grow daily more intimate while loyal words grow daily more remote, internal troubles gradually accumulate, and external danger grows ever deeper.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant cannot sleep at night or eat his fill by day, fearing that those close at hand grow ever nearer while loyal counsel grows ever more distant, internal troubles mount, and external danger deepens.

sentences.zh: 陛下超從列侯，繼承天位，小家畜產百萬之資，子孫尚恥愧失其先業，況乃產兼天下，受之先帝，而欲懈怠以自輕忽乎！

translations.literal: Your Majesty rose from among the ranked marquises to inherit the throne; even a small household with property worth a million—if descendants lose their ancestors' estate, they still feel shame; how much more when one's possessions embrace all under heaven, received from the Former Emperor—could one wish to slacken in self-neglect!
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty rose from the ranks of marquises to inherit the throne; even a small household worth a million in property would feel shame if its heirs lost the ancestral estate—how much more when the realm is yours, received from the Former Emperor, could you slacken and neglect yourself!

sentences.zh: 誠不愛己，不當念先帝得之勤苦邪！

translations.literal: If you truly do not cherish yourself, ought you not remember how the Former Emperor attained it through toil and hardship!
translations.idiomatic: If you truly do not cherish yourself, ought you not remember the Former Emperor's toil and hardship in winning the throne!

sentences.zh: 前梁氏五侯，毒遍海內，天啟聖意，收而戮之。

translations.literal: Formerly the five marquises of the Liang clan spread poison throughout the realm; Heaven opened the sage mind, and they were gathered up and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the five marquises of the Liang clan poisoned the realm; Heaven opened your mind, and they were gathered up and executed.

sentences.zh: 天下之議，冀當小平；

translations.literal: The talk of all under heaven hoped for a time of slight peace;
translations.idiomatic: All under heaven hoped for a brief respite;

sentences.zh: 明鑒未遠，覆車如昨，而近習之權，復相扇結。

translations.literal: Bright warning is not far off, overturned carts lie as yesterday—and yet the power of close attendants again fans and binds together.
translations.idiomatic: The warning is still fresh, the overturned cart still before us—yet the power of close attendants again fans and binds together.

sentences.zh: 小黃門趙津、大猾張泛等，肆行貪虐，奸媚左右。

translations.literal: Junior Palace Attendant Zhao Jin, the great rogue Zhang Fan, and others freely practiced greed and cruelty, flattering and fawning upon those at the Emperor's side.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Palace Attendant Zhao Jin, the great rogue Zhang Fan, and others practiced greed and cruelty at will, fawning on those at your side.

sentences.zh: 前太原太守劉□質、南陽太守成□糾而戮之，雖言赦後不當誅殺，原其誠心，在乎去惡，至於陛下，有何悁悁！

translations.literal: Former Taiyuan Administrator Liu Zhi and Nanyang Administrator Cheng Ji investigated and executed them; though it is said that after an amnesty one ought not kill, pardon their sincere hearts—their aim was to remove evil—as for Your Majesty, why so anxious and petty!
translations.idiomatic: Former Taiyuan Administrator Liu Zhi and Nanyang Administrator Cheng Ji investigated and executed them; though killing after an amnesty is disputed, their hearts were sincere and their aim was to remove evil—why should Your Majesty be so troubled!

sentences.zh: 而小人道長，營惑聖聽，遂使天威為之發怒，必加刑謫，已為過甚，況乃重罰令伏歐刀乎！

translations.literal: Yet the way of petty men grows long; they work to bewilder the sage ear, so that imperial authority is stirred to anger and punishment must be added—already excessive; how much more to impose heavy punishment and make them kneel before the executioner's blade!
translations.idiomatic: Yet petty men grow ever bolder; they bewilder your ear until imperial wrath demands punishment—already too much, and now you would add heavy penalties and make them kneel before the executioner's blade!

sentences.zh: 又，前山陽太守翟超、東海相黃浮，奉公不橈，疾惡如仇，超沒侯覽財物，浮誅徐宣之罪，並蒙刑坐，不逢赦恕。

translations.literal: Moreover, former Shanyang Administrator Zhai Chao and Donghai Chancellor Huang Fu served the public without bending, hating evil as if it were a personal enemy—Chao confiscated Hou Lan's property; Fu punished Xu Xuan for his crimes—both suffered punishment and received no pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, former Shanyang Administrator Zhai Chao and Donghai Chancellor Huang Fu served the public without bending and hated evil as personal foes—Chao confiscated Hou Lan's property, Fu punished Xu Xuan—and both were punished without pardon.

sentences.zh: 覽之從橫，沒財已幸；

translations.literal: Lan's overbearing ways—merely confiscating his property was already good fortune;
translations.idiomatic: Hou Lan's tyranny—merely confiscating his property was already lenient;

sentences.zh: 宣犯釁過，死有餘辜。

translations.literal: Xuan's offenses and transgressions—death left guilt to spare.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xuan's crimes deserved death many times over.

sentences.zh: 昔丞相申屠嘉召責鄧通，雒陽令董宣折辱公主，而文帝從而請之，光武加以重賞，未聞二臣有專命之誅。

translations.literal: Formerly Chancellor Shen Tu Jia summoned and rebuked Deng Tong; Luoyang Magistrate Dong Xuan shamed the princess—yet Emperor Wen followed by interceding for him, and Emperor Guangwu richly rewarded him; never was it heard that the two ministers were put to death for acting on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Chancellor Shen Tu Jia summoned and rebuked Deng Tong, and Luoyang Magistrate Dong Xuan shamed the princess—yet Emperor Wen interceded for Dong Xuan, and Emperor Guangwu richly rewarded such men; never were those ministers executed for acting on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 而今左右群豎，惡傷黨類，妄相交構，致此刑譴，聞臣是言，當復啼訴。

translations.literal: Yet now the swarm of eunuchs at the Emperor's side, hating any harm to their faction, recklessly frame one another and brought about this punishment; hearing these words of your servant, they will again wail and plead.
translations.idiomatic: Yet now the eunuchs at your side, hating any harm to their faction, fabricate charges and brought this punishment about; hearing my words, they will wail and plead again.

sentences.zh: 陛下深宜割塞近習與政之源，引納尚書朝省之士，簡練清高，斥黜佞邪。

translations.literal: Your Majesty ought deeply to cut off and block the source by which close attendants enter government, draw in and welcome the officials of the Masters of Writing and the court assemblies—select the pure and upright, dismiss the flatterers and wicked.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty ought to cut off the source by which close attendants enter government, welcome the officials of the Masters of Writing and the court assemblies, select the pure and upright, and dismiss flatterers and the wicked.

sentences.zh: 如是天和於上，地洽於下，休禎符瑞，豈遠乎哉！

translations.literal: If so, Heaven will be harmonious above and Earth will be in accord below—how far off could auspicious signs and portents be!
translations.idiomatic: If so, Heaven will be harmonious above and Earth in accord below—how far could auspicious signs be!

sentences.zh: 」帝不納。

translations.literal: " The Emperor did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor did not accept it.

sentences.zh: 宦官由此疾蕃彌甚，選舉奏議，輒以中詔譴卻，長史以下多至抵罪，猶以蕃名臣，不敢加害。

translations.literal: From this the eunuchs hated Fan all the more; whenever selections or memorials were submitted, they would use imperial edicts from the inner palace to rebuke and reject them; many from Chief Clerk downward were punished—all the more because Fan was a famous minister, they did not dare harm him.
translations.idiomatic: From this the eunuchs hated Fan all the more; whenever selections or memorials were submitted, inner-palace edicts rebuked and rejected them, and many from chief clerk downward were punished; because Fan was a famous minister, they did not dare harm him.

sentences.zh: 平原襄楷詣闕上疏曰：「臣聞皇天不言，以文象設教。

translations.literal: Xiang Kai of Pingyuan went to the palace gate and submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant has heard that August Heaven is wordless and sets forth teaching through celestial patterns and images.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Kai of Pingyuan went to the palace gate and submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant has heard that August Heaven is wordless and teaches through celestial patterns and images.

sentences.zh: 臣竊見太微、天廷五帝之坐，而金、火罰星揚光其中，於占，天子凶；

translations.literal: Your servant has secretly observed the Seat of the Five Emperors in the Supreme Palace Enclosure and the Celestial Court, with the punishing stars Metal and Fire blazing bright therein—by divination, this bodes ill for the Son of Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has observed the Seat of the Five Emperors in the Supreme Palace Enclosure and Celestial Court, with the punishing stars Metal and Fire blazing therein—by divination, this bodes ill for the Son of Heaven;

sentences.zh: 又俱入房、心，法無繼嗣。

translations.literal: Moreover both have entered Fang and Xin—the rule indicates no successor.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover both have entered Fang and Xin—the rule indicates no successor.

sentences.zh: 前年冬大寒，殺鳥獸，害魚鱉，城傍竹柏之葉有傷枯者。

translations.literal: In the winter before last, extreme cold killed birds and beasts, harmed fish and turtles; leaves of bamboo and cypress beside the walls withered and died.
translations.idiomatic: Two winters ago, extreme cold killed birds and beasts, harmed fish and turtles, and bamboo and cypress leaves beside the walls withered.

sentences.zh: 臣聞於師曰：『柏傷竹枯，不出二年，天子當之。

translations.literal: Your servant heard from his teacher: 'When cypress is injured and bamboo withers, within two years the Son of Heaven must answer for it.'
translations.idiomatic: Your servant heard from his teacher: 'When cypress is injured and bamboo withers, within two years the Son of Heaven must answer for it.'

sentences.zh: 』今自春夏以來，連有霜雹及大雨雷電，臣作威作福，刑罰急刻之所感也。

translations.literal: ' From spring through summer until now, frost and hail have repeatedly fallen along with great rain, thunder, and lightning—these are stirred by ministers who act with authority and dispense favor, and by punishments that are harsh and severe.
translations.idiomatic: ' From spring through summer until now, frost and hail have repeatedly fallen along with great rain, thunder, and lightning—these are stirred by ministers who act with authority and dispense favor, and by punishments harsh and severe.

sentences.zh: 太原太守劉□質，南陽太守成□，志除奸邪，其所誅翦，皆合人望。

translations.literal: Taiyuan Administrator Liu Zhi and Nanyang Administrator Cheng Ji wished to remove wickedness and evil; those they cut down all accorded with the people's hopes.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan Administrator Liu Zhi and Nanyang Administrator Cheng Ji wished to remove wickedness; those they cut down all accorded with the people's hopes.

sentences.zh: 而陛下受閹豎之譖，乃遠加考逮。

translations.literal: Yet Your Majesty accepted the eunuchs' slander and sent officials far away to investigate and arrest them.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Your Majesty accepted the eunuchs' slander and sent officials far away to investigate and arrest them.

sentences.zh: 三公上書乞哀□質等，不見采察而嚴被譴讓，憂國之任，將遂杜口矣。

translations.literal: The Three Excellencies submitted memorials begging mercy for Liu Zhi and the others—their pleas were neither heeded nor examined, but they were sternly rebuked; the burden of caring for the state will soon seal mouths entirely.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Excellencies begged mercy for Liu Zhi and the others—their pleas went unheeded and they were sternly rebuked; those charged with caring for the state will soon fall silent.

sentences.zh: 臣聞殺無罪，誅賢者，禍及三世。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that killing the innocent and executing the worthy brings calamity upon three generations.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has heard that killing the innocent and executing the worthy brings calamity upon three generations.

sentences.zh: 自陛下即位以來，頻行誅罰，梁、寇、孫、鄧並見族滅，其從坐者又非其數。

translations.literal: Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, executions and punishments have been frequent—the Liang, Kou, Sun, and Deng clans were all wiped out to the last, and those implicated with them are beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, executions and punishments have been frequent—the Liang, Kou, Sun, and Deng clans were wiped out to the last, and those implicated with them are beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 李雲上書，明主所不當諱；

translations.literal: Li Yun submitted a memorial—what a bright ruler ought not taboo;
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun submitted a memorial on what a bright ruler ought not taboo;

sentences.zh: 杜眾乞死，諒以感悟聖朝；

translations.literal: Du Zhong begged for death, presumably to awaken the sacred court;
translations.idiomatic: Du Zhong begged for death, presumably to awaken the sacred court;

sentences.zh: 曾無赦宥而並被殘戮，天下之人咸知其冤，漢興以來，未有拒諫誅賢，用刑太深如今者也。

translations.literal: Yet there was no pardon but only brutal slaughter together; all under heaven know their injustice—in the rise of Han until now, never has rejection of remonstrance, execution of worthies, and use of punishment so deep as today been seen.
translations.idiomatic: Yet there was no pardon, only brutal slaughter; all under heaven know their injustice—in all the rise of Han, never has remonstrance been rejected, worthies executed, and punishment wielded so deeply as today.

sentences.zh: 昔文王一妻，誕致十子；

translations.literal: Formerly King Wen had one wife and she bore ten sons;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly King Wen had one wife and she bore ten sons;

sentences.zh: 今宮女數千，未聞慶育，宜修德省刑以廣《螽斯》之祚。

translations.literal: now palace women number in the thousands, yet no blessed births are heard—Your Majesty ought to cultivate virtue and reduce punishments to extend the blessing of the Zhongsi Ode.
translations.idiomatic: now palace women number in the thousands, yet no blessed births are heard—Your Majesty ought to cultivate virtue and reduce punishments to extend the blessing of the Zhongsi Ode.

sentences.zh: 案春秋以來，及古帝王，未有河清。

translations.literal: Examining from the Spring and Autumn period onward, and the ancient emperors and kings—never was the Yellow River clear.
translations.idiomatic: Examining from the Spring and Autumn period onward, and among ancient emperors and kings—never was the Yellow River clear.

sentences.zh: 臣以為河者，諸侯位也。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that the river represents the rank of feudal lords;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant considers that the river represents the rank of feudal lords;

sentences.zh: 清者，屬陽；

translations.literal: what is clear belongs to yang;
translations.idiomatic: what is clear belongs to yang;

sentences.zh: 濁者，屬陰。

translations.literal: what is turbid belongs to yin.
translations.idiomatic: what is turbid belongs to yin.

sentences.zh: 河當濁而反清者，陰欲為陽，諸侯欲為帝也。

translations.literal: When the river ought to be turbid yet turns clear—yin wishes to become yang, feudal lords wish to become emperors.
translations.idiomatic: When the river ought to be turbid yet turns clear—yin wishes to become yang, feudal lords wish to become emperors.

sentences.zh: 京房《易傳》曰：『河水清，天下平。

translations.literal: In Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes it says: 'When the Yellow River is clear, all under heaven is at peace.'
translations.idiomatic: In Jing Fang's Commentary on the Changes it says: 'When the Yellow River is clear, all under heaven is at peace.'

sentences.zh: 』今天垂異，地吐妖，人癘疫，三者並時而有河清，猶春秋麟不當見而見，孔子書之以為異也。

translations.literal: ' Today Heaven sends forth anomalies, Earth spews portents, and people suffer pestilence—all three at once, and yet the Yellow River is clear; it is like the unicorn in the Spring and Autumn, which ought not to appear yet appeared—Confucius recorded it as an anomaly.
translations.idiomatic: ' Today Heaven sends forth anomalies, Earth spews portents, and people suffer pestilence—all three at once, and yet the Yellow River is clear; it is like the unicorn in the Spring and Autumn Annals, which ought not to appear yet appeared—Confucius recorded it as an anomaly.

sentences.zh: 願賜清閒，極盡所言。

translations.literal: I beg to be granted leisure and quiet to speak my utmost.
translations.idiomatic: I beg to be granted leisure and quiet to speak my utmost.

sentences.zh: 」書奏，不省。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, it was not examined.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, it was not examined.

sentences.zh: 十餘日，復上書曰：「臣聞殷紂好色，妲己是出；

translations.literal: After more than ten days, he again submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant has heard that Yin Zhou loved beauty, and Daji issued forth from it;
translations.idiomatic: After more than ten days, he again submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant has heard that King Zhou of Yin loved beauty, and Daji issued forth from it;

sentences.zh: 葉公好龍，真龍游廷。

translations.literal: Lord Ye loved dragons, and a true dragon wandered the court.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ye loved dragons, and a true dragon wandered the court.

sentences.zh: 今黃門、常侍，天刑之人，陛下愛待，兼倍常寵，系嗣未兆，豈不為此！

translations.literal: Now the Yellow Gates and Regular Attendants are men marked by Heaven's punishment—Your Majesty loves and treats them, doubling ordinary favor; the line of succession shows no sign—could it not be because of this!
translations.idiomatic: Now the Yellow Gates and Regular Attendants are men marked by Heaven's punishment—Your Majesty loves and favors them beyond measure; the line of succession shows no sign—could it not be because of this!

sentences.zh: 又聞宮中立黃、老、浮屠之祠，此道清虛，貴尚無為，好生惡殺，省欲去奢。

translations.literal: Your servant also hears that within the palace shrines to Huang-Lao and Buddhism have been established—this Way is clear and empty, honoring non-action, loving life and hating killing, reducing desire and abandoning extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant also hears that within the palace shrines to Huang-Lao and Buddhism have been established—this Way is clear and empty, honors non-action, loves life and hates killing, and reduces desire and abandons extravagance.

sentences.zh: 今陛下耆欲不去，殺罰過理，既乖其道，豈獲其祚哉！

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty will not put away desires of old age; killing and punishment exceed reason—having already strayed from this Way, how could one obtain its blessing!
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty will not put away old desires; killing and punishment exceed reason—having already strayed from this Way, how could you obtain its blessing!

sentences.zh: 浮屠不三宿桑下，不欲久生恩愛，精之至也；

translations.literal: The Buddha does not lodge three nights beneath a mulberry tree, unwilling to let affection grow long—such is the utmost of refinement;
translations.idiomatic: The Buddha does not lodge three nights beneath a mulberry tree, unwilling to let affection grow long—such is the utmost refinement;

sentences.zh: 其守一如此，乃能成道。

translations.literal: holding to the one with such constancy, only then can one attain the Way.
translations.idiomatic: holding to the one with such constancy, only then can one attain the Way.

sentences.zh: 今陛下淫女艷婦，極天下之麗，甘肥飲美，單天下之味，奈何欲如黃、老乎！

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty's licentious women and gorgeous consorts exhaust all beauty under heaven; savory meats and fine drink exhaust all flavors under heaven—how could you wish to be like Huang-Lao!
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty's licentious women and gorgeous consorts exhaust all beauty under heaven; savory meats and fine drink exhaust all flavors under heaven—how could you wish to be like Huang-Lao!

sentences.zh: 」書上，即召入，詔尚書問狀。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, he was immediately summoned in; an edict ordered the Masters of Writing to inquire into the circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, he was immediately summoned in; an edict ordered the Masters of Writing to inquire into the circumstances.

sentences.zh: 楷言：「古者本無宦臣，武帝末數游後宮，始置之耳。

translations.literal: Kai said: "In antiquity there were originally no palace eunuchs; only at the end of Emperor Wu's reign, when he often roamed the inner palace, were they first established."
translations.idiomatic: Kai said: "In antiquity there were originally no palace eunuchs; only at the end of Emperor Wu's reign, when he often roamed the inner palace, were they first established."

sentences.zh: 」尚書承旨，奏：「楷不正辭理，而違背經藝，假借星宿，造合私意，誣上罔事，請下司隸正楷罪法，收送雒陽獄。

translations.literal: " The Masters of Writing, following the imperial intent, memorialized: "Kai does not argue with correct reasoning but violates the canonical classics, borrows celestial signs, fabricates what suits private intent, deceives the sovereign and misleads affairs—we request he be handed to the Director of Retainers to determine guilt under law and sent to Luoyang prison."
translations.idiomatic: " The Masters of Writing, following the imperial intent, memorialized: "Kai does not argue with correct reasoning but violates the canonical classics, borrows celestial signs, fabricates what suits private intent, deceives the sovereign and misleads affairs—we request he be handed to the Director of Retainers to determine guilt under law and sent to Luoyang prison."

sentences.zh: 」帝以楷言雖激切，然皆天文恆象之數，故不誅；

translations.literal: " The Emperor, though Kai's words were sharp and extreme, considered them all numbers of fixed astronomical signs, and therefore did not execute him;
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor, though Kai's words were sharp and extreme, considered them all fixed astronomical signs, and therefore did not execute him;

sentences.zh: 猶司寇論刑。

translations.literal: Still had the Minister of Crime determine punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Still referred the case to the Minister of Crime for sentencing.

sentences.zh: 自永平以來，臣民雖有習浮屠術者，而天子未之好；

translations.literal: Since Yongping, though subjects and people have practiced Buddhist arts, the Son of Heaven has not favored them;
translations.idiomatic: Since the Yongping era, subjects and commoners have practiced Buddhist arts, yet the Son of Heaven has not favored them;

sentences.zh: 至帝，始篤好之，常躬自禱祠，由是其法侵盛，故楷言及之。

translations.literal: when this Emperor came, he began to love them fervently, often personally praying and sacrificing; from this its Law gradually flourished, and therefore Kai spoke of it.
translations.idiomatic: under this Emperor he began to love it fervently, often praying and sacrificing in person; from this its teachings spread ever wider, and therefore Kai spoke of it.

sentences.zh: 符節令汝南蔡衍、議郎劉瑜表救成□、劉□質，言甚切厲，亦坐免官。

translations.literal: Keeper of Credentials Cai Yan of Runan and Gentleman Consultant Liu Yu memorialized to save Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi—their words extremely sharp and stern—and they too were stripped of office on that account.
translations.idiomatic: Keeper of Credentials Cai Yan of Runan and Gentleman Consultant Liu Yu memorialized to save Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi in language sharp and stern, and they too were dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: □、□質竟死獄中。

translations.literal: Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi ultimately died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi ultimately died in prison.

sentences.zh: □、□質素剛直，有經術，知名當時，故天下惜之。

translations.literal: Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi had always been upright and firm, versed in the classics, famed in their time, and therefore all under heaven regretted their deaths.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Ji and Liu Zhi had always been upright and firm, versed in the classics, and famed in their day, and all under heaven mourned them.

sentences.zh: 岑晊、張牧逃竄獲免。

translations.literal: Cen Qi and Zhang Mu fled into hiding and escaped punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Qi and Zhang Mu fled into hiding and escaped punishment.

sentences.zh: 晊之亡也，親友競匿之；

translations.literal: When Qi was fleeing, friends and kin competed to hide him;
translations.idiomatic: When Qi was on the run, friends and kin competed to hide him;

sentences.zh: 賈彪獨閉門不納，時人望之。

translations.literal: Jia Biao alone shut his door and did not admit him—people of the time looked to him in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Biao alone shut his door and refused him entry, and people of the time admired him for it.

sentences.zh: 彪曰：「傳言『相時而動，無累後人。

translations.literal: Biao said: "The tradition says, 'Act according to the times, and do not burden posterity.'"
translations.idiomatic: Biao said: "The tradition says, 'Act according to the times, and do not burden posterity.'"

sentences.zh: 』公孝以要君致釁，自遺其咎，至已不能奮戈相待，反可容隱之乎！

translations.literal: Gongxiao sought to force the ruler's hand and brought on calamity, bringing ruin on himself; now that he cannot even brandish a spear in defense, how can one still shelter and conceal him!"
translations.idiomatic: Gongxiao forced the ruler's hand and brought calamity on himself; now that he cannot even raise a spear in his own defense, how can one still shelter him!"

sentences.zh: 」於是鹹服其裁正。

translations.literal: Thereupon all submitted to his judgment and rectification.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon all submitted to his judgment.

sentences.zh: 彪嘗為新息長，小民困貧，多不養子；

translations.literal: Biao had once been Magistrate of Xinxing; the common people, pressed by poverty, often did not rear their children;
translations.idiomatic: Biao had once been Magistrate of Xinxing; the common people, crushed by poverty, often abandoned their children;

sentences.zh: 彪嚴為其制，與殺人同罪。

translations.literal: Biao sternly established regulations for this, making it the same crime as murder.
translations.idiomatic: Biao sternly made regulations treating it as the same crime as murder.

sentences.zh: 城南有盜劫害人者，北有婦人殺子者。

translations.literal: South of the city there was a robber who plundered and killed people; north there was a woman who killed her child.
translations.idiomatic: South of the city a robber plundered and killed people; north of the city a woman killed her child.

sentences.zh: 彪出案驗，掾吏欲引南，彪怒曰：「賊寇害人，此則常理；

translations.literal: Biao went out to investigate; the clerks wished to lead him south. Biao angrily said: "Bandits harming people—this is ordinary reason;
translations.idiomatic: Biao went out to investigate; the clerks wished to lead him south. Biao angrily said: "Bandits harming people—that is ordinary;

sentences.zh: 母子相殘，逆天違道！

translations.literal: mother and child destroying each other—this defies Heaven and violates the Way!"
translations.idiomatic: mother and child destroying each other—that defies Heaven and violates the Way!"

sentences.zh: 」遂驅車北行，案致其罪。

translations.literal: Thereupon he drove his carriage north and investigated to establish her guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he drove north and prosecuted her to conviction.

sentences.zh: 城南賊聞之，亦面縛自首。

translations.literal: When the bandit south of the city heard of this, he too bound himself and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandit south of the city heard of this, he too bound himself and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 數年間，人養子者以千數。

translations.literal: Within a few years, those who reared children numbered in the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years, those who reared children numbered in the thousands.

sentences.zh: 曰：「此賈父所生也。

translations.literal: (People) said: "This is what Prefect Jia gave life to."
translations.idiomatic: People said: "This is what Prefect Jia gave life to."

sentences.zh: 」皆名之為賈。

translations.literal: All named their children Jia.
translations.idiomatic: All named their children Jia.

sentences.zh: 河內張成，善風角，推占當赦，教子殺人。

translations.literal: Zhang Cheng of Henei was skilled at wind-angle divination; calculating that an amnesty was coming, he taught his son to kill someone.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cheng of Henei was skilled at wind-angle divination; calculating that an amnesty was coming, he taught his son to kill a man.

sentences.zh: 司隸李膺督促收捕，既而逢宥獲免；

translations.literal: Director of the Retainers Li Ying pressed the hunt for arrest; soon afterward an amnesty intervened and he was spared;
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Retainers Li Ying pressed the hunt for his arrest; soon afterward an amnesty intervened and he was spared;

sentences.zh: 膺愈懷憤疾，竟案殺之。

translations.literal: Ying's resentment burned still hotter, and in the end he prosecuted the case and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Ying's resentment burned hotter still, and in the end he prosecuted the case and executed him.

sentences.zh: 成素以方伎交通宦官，帝亦頗訊其占；

translations.literal: Cheng had long used occult arts to maintain ties with the eunuchs, and the Emperor also frequently inquired into his divination;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng had long used occult arts to cultivate ties with the eunuchs, and the Emperor also frequently inquired into his divinations;

sentences.zh: 宦官教成弟子牢修上書，告「膺等養太學游士，交結諸郡生徒，更相驅馳，共為部黨，誹訕朝廷，疑亂風俗。

translations.literal: the eunuchs had Cheng's disciple Lao Xiu submit a memorial, accusing "Ying and others of maintaining roaming scholars of the Imperial Academy, forging ties with student disciples in the various commanderies, driving one another on in succession, forming partisan cliques together, slandering the court, and casting doubt upon and disturbing custom."
translations.idiomatic: the eunuchs had Cheng's disciple Lao Xiu submit a memorial accusing Ying and others of "maintaining roaming scholars of the Imperial Academy, forging ties with student disciples in the various commanderies, driving one another on, forming partisan cliques, slandering the court, and disturbing custom."

sentences.zh: 」於是天子震怒，班下郡國，逮捕黨人，佈告天下，使同忿疾。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Son of Heaven was deeply angered, issued orders to the commanderies and kingdoms, arrested the partisans, proclaimed it to all under heaven, and made all share in wrath and loathing.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Son of Heaven was deeply angered, issued orders to the commanderies and kingdoms, arrested the partisans, proclaimed it to all under heaven, and made all share in wrath and loathing.

sentences.zh: 案經三府，太尉陳蕃卻之曰：「今所案者，皆海內人譽，憂國忠公之臣，此等猶將十世宥也，豈有罪名不章而致收掠者乎！

translations.literal: The case passed through the Three Excellencies; Grand Commandant Chen Fan refused it, saying: "Those now under prosecution are all men of reputation within the seas, ministers loyal to the state and devoted to the public good—such men would receive pardon even to the tenth generation; how could there be men whose crimes are not clearly stated yet are seized and plundered!"
translations.idiomatic: The case passed through the Three Excellencies; Grand Commandant Chen Fan refused it, saying: "Those now under prosecution are all men of reputation throughout the realm, loyal ministers devoted to the public good—such men would receive pardon even to the tenth generation; how can men whose crimes are not clearly stated be seized and plundered!"

sentences.zh: 」不肯平署。

translations.literal: He refused to countersign with approval.
translations.idiomatic: He refused to countersign.

sentences.zh: 帝愈怒，遂下膺等於黃門北寺獄，其辭所連及，太僕穎川杜密、御史中丞陳翔及陳寔、范滂之徒二百餘人。

translations.literal: The Emperor's anger grew still greater; he thereupon sent Ying and others down to the prison of the Northern Monastery of the Yellow Gate. Those implicated in their confessions included Grand Steward Du Mi of Yingchuan, Director of the Masters of Writing Chen Xiang, Chen Shi, Fan Pang, and more than two hundred others.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's anger grew still greater; he thereupon sent Ying and others to the prison of the Northern Monastery of the Yellow Gate. Those implicated in their confessions included Grand Steward Du Mi of Yingchuan, Director of the Masters of Writing Chen Xiang, Chen Shi, Fan Pang, and more than two hundred others.

sentences.zh: 或逃遁不獲，皆懸金購募，使者四出相望。

translations.literal: Some fled and could not be captured; all had bounties posted in gold for their pursuit; envoys went forth in all directions, one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Some fled and could not be captured; bounties in gold were posted for them all; envoys went forth in all directions, one after another.

sentences.zh: 陳寔曰：「吾不就獄，眾無所恃。

translations.literal: Chen Shi said: "If I do not go to prison, the masses will have nothing to rely on."
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shi said: "If I do not go to prison, the masses will have nothing to rely on."

sentences.zh: 」乃自往請囚。

translations.literal: Thereupon he went of his own accord to surrender for imprisonment.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he went of his own accord to surrender for imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 范滂至獄，獄吏謂曰：「凡坐系者，皆祭皋陶。

translations.literal: When Fan Pang arrived at prison, the prison officer said to him: "All who are imprisoned here sacrifice to Gao Yao."
translations.idiomatic: When Fan Pang arrived at prison, the prison officer said to him: "All who are imprisoned here sacrifice to Gao Yao."

sentences.zh: 」滂曰：「皋陶，古之直臣，知滂無罪，將理之於帝，如其有罪，祭之何益！

translations.literal: Pang said: "Gao Yao was an upright minister of antiquity; knowing that Pang is guiltless, he will plead my case before the Emperor—if I am guilty, what use is sacrifice!"
translations.idiomatic: Pang said: "Gao Yao was an upright minister of antiquity; knowing that Pang is guiltless, he will plead my case before the Emperor—if I am guilty, what use is sacrifice!"

sentences.zh: 」眾人由此亦止。

translations.literal: From this the others also stopped.
translations.idiomatic: From this the others also stopped.

sentences.zh: 陳蕃復上書極諫，帝諱其言切，托以蕃辟召非其人，策免之。

translations.literal: Chen Fan again submitted a memorial remonstrating to the utmost; the Emperor resented his sharp words, using as pretext that Fan had recommended the wrong man for appointment, and dismissed him by edict.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Fan again submitted a memorial remonstrating to the utmost; the Emperor resented his sharp words, using as pretext that Fan had recommended the wrong man for appointment, and dismissed him by edict.

sentences.zh: 時黨人獄所染逮者，皆天下名賢，度遼將軍皇甫規，自以西州豪桀，恥不得與，乃自上言：「臣前薦故大司農張奐，是附黨也。

translations.literal: At the time those implicated in the partisan prison case were all famous worthies under heaven. General Who Crosses the Liao Huangfu Gui, considering himself a magnate of the western provinces, was shamed at not being included; he therefore submitted a memorial of his own, saying: "Your servant formerly recommended the late Grand Minister of Agriculture Zhang Huan—this is attachment to the partisans."
translations.idiomatic: At the time those implicated in the partisan prison case were all famous worthies under heaven. General Who Crosses the Liao Huangfu Gui, considering himself a magnate of the western provinces, was shamed at not being included; he therefore submitted a memorial of his own, saying: "Your servant formerly recommended the late Grand Minister of Agriculture Zhang Huan—this is attachment to the partisans."

sentences.zh: 又，臣昔論輸左校時，太學生張鳳等上書訟臣，是為黨人所附也，臣宜坐之。

translations.literal: "Moreover, when Your servant was formerly sentenced to labor in the Left Construction Corps, Imperial Academy students Zhang Feng and others submitted memorials pleading my cause—this shows attachment by the partisans; Your servant ought to be punished for it."
translations.idiomatic: "Moreover, when Your servant was formerly sentenced to labor in the Left Construction Corps, Imperial Academy students Zhang Feng and others submitted memorials pleading my cause—this shows attachment by the partisans; Your servant ought to be punished for it."

sentences.zh: 」朝廷知而不問。

translations.literal: The court knew of this but made no inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The court knew of this but made no inquiry.

sentences.zh: 杜密素與李膺名行相次，時人謂之李、杜，故同時被系。

translations.literal: Du Mi's reputation and conduct had always ranked next to Li Ying's; people of the time called them Li and Du—therefore both were imprisoned at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: Du Mi's reputation and conduct had always ranked next to Li Ying's; people of the time called them Li and Du—therefore both were imprisoned at the same time.

sentences.zh: 密嘗為北海相，行春，到高密，見鄭玄為鄉嗇夫，知其異器，即召署郡職，遂遣就學，卒成大儒。

translations.literal: Mi had once been Chancellor of Beihai; on his spring inspection tour he came to Gaomi, saw Zheng Xuan serving as district bailiff, knew him to be extraordinary material, immediately summoned him and assigned him a commandery post, then sent him to pursue study—he ultimately became a great Confucian.
translations.idiomatic: Mi had once been Chancellor of Beihai; on his spring inspection tour he came to Gaomi, saw Zheng Xuan serving as district bailiff, recognized him as extraordinary talent, immediately summoned him and assigned him a commandery post, then sent him to pursue study—he ultimately became a great Confucian.

sentences.zh: 後密去官還家，每謁守令，多所陳托。

translations.literal: Later, after Mi left office and returned home, whenever he called on the prefect and magistrates he often made many requests on others' behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Later, after Mi left office and returned home, whenever he called on the prefect and magistrates he often made many requests on others' behalf.

sentences.zh: 同郡劉勝，亦自蜀郡告歸鄉里，閉門掃軌，無所幹及。

translations.literal: Liu Sheng of the same commandery had likewise returned from Shu commandery to his home district; he shut his door, swept his tracks, and had no dealings with anyone.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Sheng of the same commandery had likewise returned from Shu commandery to his home district; he shut his door, swept his tracks, and had no dealings with anyone.

sentences.zh: 太守王昱謂密曰：「劉季陵清高士，公卿多舉之者。

translations.literal: Prefect Wang Yu said to Mi: "Liu Jiling is a lofty and pure gentleman; many high officials recommend him."
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wang Yu said to Mi: "Liu Jiling is a lofty and pure gentleman; many high officials recommend him."

sentences.zh: 密知昱以激己，對曰：「劉勝位為大夫，見禮上賓，而知善不薦，聞惡無言，隱情惜己，自同寒蟬，此罪人也。

translations.literal: Mi knew Yu was trying to provoke him, and replied: "Liu Sheng holds the rank of Grandee, is received as an honored guest—yet knowing good he does not recommend it, hearing evil he says nothing, concealing his feelings and sparing himself, making himself like a winter cicada—this is a criminal man."
