translations.idiomatic: Mi knew Yu was trying to provoke him, and replied: "Liu Sheng holds the rank of Grandee and is received as an honored guest—yet knowing good he does not recommend it, hearing evil he says nothing, concealing his feelings and sparing himself, making himself like a winter cicada—this is a criminal man."

sentences.zh: 今志義力行之賢而密達之，違道失節之士而密糾之，使明府賞刑得中，令問休揚，不亦萬分之一乎！

translations.literal: "Now if Your servant reports worthy men of resolute purpose and forceful action, and privately denounces men who stray from the Way and lose integrity, would this not be one ten-thousandth of enabling Your Excellence to reward and punish with due measure, so that your reputation for good governance flourishes!"
translations.idiomatic: "Now if Your servant reports worthy men of resolute purpose and forceful action, and privately denounces men who stray from the Way and lose integrity, would this not be one ten-thousandth of enabling Your Excellence to reward and punish with due measure, so that your reputation for good governance flourishes!"

sentences.zh: 」昱慚服，待之彌厚。

translations.literal: Yu felt shame and submitted; he treated Mi still more generously.
translations.idiomatic: Yu felt shame and submitted; he treated Mi still more generously.

sentences.zh: 九月，以光祿勳周景為太尉。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zhou Jing was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zhou Jing was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 司空劉茂免。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Liu Mao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Liu Mao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 冬，十二月，以光祿勳汝南宣酆為司空。

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Xuan Feng of Runan was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the twelfth month, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Xuan Feng of Runan was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 以越騎校尉竇武為城門校尉。

translations.literal: Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Dou Wu was made Colonel of the City Gates.
translations.idiomatic: Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Dou Wu was made Colonel of the City Gates.

sentences.zh: 武在位，多辟名士，清身疾惡，禮賂不通。

translations.literal: Wu in office extensively recruited famous scholars, kept his person pure and hated evil, and would not accept bribes through ritual gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In office Wu extensively recruited famous scholars, kept himself pure and hated evil, and would not accept bribes through ritual gifts.

sentences.zh: 妻子衣食裁充足而已。

translations.literal: His wife and children had clothing and food barely sufficient—that was all.
translations.idiomatic: His wife and children had clothing and food barely sufficient—that was all.

sentences.zh: 得兩宮賞賜，悉散與太學諸生及丐施貧民。

translations.literal: Whatever rewards he received from the two palaces he distributed entirely to Imperial Academy students and as alms to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever rewards he received from the two palaces he distributed entirely to Imperial Academy students and as alms to the poor.

sentences.zh: 由是眾譽歸之。

translations.literal: From this public praise converged upon him.
translations.idiomatic: From this public praise converged upon him.

sentences.zh: 匈奴烏桓聞張奐至，皆相率還降，凡二十萬口；

translations.literal: When the Xiongnu and Wuhuan heard that Zhang Huan had arrived, they all led one another back to surrender—two hundred thousand persons in all;
translations.idiomatic: When the Xiongnu and Wuhuan heard that Zhang Huan had arrived, they all led one another back to surrender—two hundred thousand persons in all;

sentences.zh: 奐但誅其首惡，餘皆慰納之。

translations.literal: Huan only executed the chief ringleaders; the rest he comforted and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Huan only executed the chief ringleaders; the rest he comforted and accepted.

sentences.zh: 唯鮮卑出塞去。

translations.literal: Only the Xianbei went outside the passes and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Xianbei went outside the passes and departed.

sentences.zh: 朝廷患檀石槐不能制，遣使持印綬封為王，欲與和親。

translations.literal: The court, troubled that Tanshihuai could not be controlled, sent envoys bearing seals and ribbons to enfeoff him as king, wishing to make peace through marriage alliance.
translations.idiomatic: The court, troubled that Tanshihuai could not be controlled, sent envoys bearing seals and ribbons to enfeoff him as king, wishing to make peace through marriage alliance.

sentences.zh: 檀石槐不肯受，而寇抄滋甚。

translations.literal: Tanshihuai refused to accept, and raids and plundering grew still worse.
translations.idiomatic: Tanshihuai refused to accept, and raids and plundering grew still worse.

sentences.zh: 自分其地為三部：從右北平以東至遼東，接夫餘、濊貊二十餘邑，為東部；

translations.literal: He himself divided his territory into three parts: from Right Beiping eastward to Liaodong, touching Buyeo and Yemaek in more than twenty settlements—this was the Eastern Division;
translations.idiomatic: He himself divided his territory into three parts: from Right Beiping eastward to Liaodong, touching Buyeo and Yemaek in more than twenty settlements—this was the Eastern Division;

sentences.zh: 從右北平以西，至上谷十餘邑，為中部；

translations.literal: from west of Right Beiping to Shanggu in more than ten settlements—this was the Central Division;
translations.idiomatic: from west of Right Beiping to Shanggu in more than ten settlements—this was the Central Division;

sentences.zh: 從上谷以西至敦煌、烏孫二十餘邑，為西部。

translations.literal: from west of Shanggu to Dunhuang and Wusun in more than twenty settlements—this was the Western Division.
translations.idiomatic: from west of Shanggu to Dunhuang and Wusun in more than twenty settlements—this was the Western Division.

sentences.zh: 各置大人領之。

translations.literal: Each division had a great chief appointed to lead it.
translations.idiomatic: Each division had a great chief appointed to lead it.
